<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Kalukuri Praneeth – ECE Student Portfolio</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600;700&family=Open+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400;1,600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#0d0d0d;--card:#141414;--line:#2a2a2a;--text:#f2f2f2;--mute:#9a9a9a;--ink:#0d0d0d;
  --mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  --sans:"Open Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  color-scheme:dark;box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font:400 14px/1.6 var(--sans)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--mono);margin:0}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}
em{font-style:italic;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
p{margin:0}
.mute{color:var(--mute)}

/* nav */
nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:20px 0}
nav .logo{font:600 14px var(--mono)}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:18px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font:400 12px var(--mono);color:var(--mute)}
nav ul a:hover{color:var(--text)}

/* pills & buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:38px;padding:0 28px;border-radius:99px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font:italic 600 13px var(--sans);border:0;cursor:pointer;min-width:150px}
.pill.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:400;min-width:0}
.circle{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);display:inline-grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px;flex:none;background:transparent;color:var(--text)}
.circle.solid{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:#fff}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.tag{font:400 11px var(--mono);color:var(--mute);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:4px 12px}
.social a{font:italic 400 11px var(--sans);color:var(--mute);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 14px}
.social a:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:#555}

/* hero */
.hero{display:grid;gap:36px;padding:28px 0 56px;align-items:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,8vw,64px);line-height:1.08;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.hero h1 span{display:block;text-align:right}
.hero .lead{color:var(--mute);max-width:44ch;margin:20px 0 24px;font-size:15px}
.hero .social{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:22px}
.photo{border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/4.2;background:#1b1b1b;position:relative;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%;display:block}
.photo.tall{aspect-ratio:4/5}.photo.tall img{object-position:center 12%}


/* section heads */
.label{font:400 12px var(--mono);color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:22px}
section{padding:48px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.big{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,44px);font-weight:700;text-align:right;margin-bottom:28px}

/* about */
.about{display:grid;gap:28px}
.about p.hello{font-size:18px;color:var(--mute);max-width:48ch}


/* skills */
.cards{display:grid;gap:14px}
.box{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:18px 20px;background:var(--card)}
.box.light{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:#fff}
.box h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px}
.box p{font:400 11.5px/1.9 var(--mono);color:var(--mute)}
.box.light p{color:#333}
@media(min-width:620px){.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(min-width:900px){.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}

/* timeline */
.rows{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:16px;padding:16px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font:400 12px/1.6 var(--mono)}
.row small{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:11px}
.row.on{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.row.on small{color:#555}
.row b{font-weight:600}
.total{text-align:right;margin-top:22px;color:var(--mute);font-size:13px}

/* projects */
.projects{display:grid;gap:44px}
.proj .thumb{border-radius:26px;aspect-ratio:16/10;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.proj .thumb i{position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:16px;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal}
.t1{background:radial-gradient(circle at 25% 30%,#6c7bd9,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%,#2b3a67,transparent 60%),#10131f}
.t2{background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 25%,#d9a66c,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(circle at 20% 85%,#5b3a2b,transparent 60%),#1a1410}
.t3{background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 70%,#6cd9b0,transparent 55%),radial-gradient(circle at 85% 20%,#2b6760,transparent 60%),#0f1a18}
.proj h3{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:10px}
.proj .tags{margin-bottom:14px}
.proj p{color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:10px;font-size:13px}
.proj .links{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
@media(min-width:820px){.projects{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:28px}}

.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.gal figure{margin:0}.gal img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;border-radius:26px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:block}.gal figcaption{font:400 11px var(--mono);color:var(--mute);margin-top:10px}
@media(min-width:820px){.gal{max-width:560px}}
/* education */
.edu{display:grid;gap:14px}
@media(min-width:820px){.edu{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}

/* contact */
.contact{display:grid;gap:36px}
form{display:grid;gap:12px}
label{font:400 11px var(--mono);color:var(--mute);display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
input,textarea{width:100%;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 16px;color:var(--text);font:400 13px var(--sans)}
textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:#666}
.status{font:400 12px var(--mono);color:var(--mute);min-height:18px}
.bigname{font:700 clamp(36px,7vw,64px)/1.05 var(--mono);margin-top:12px}
.bigname span{display:block;text-align:right}
.bigname small{display:block;font:400 12px var(--sans);color:var(--mute)}
.channels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:22px}
.channels a{text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:9px;font:italic 400 12px var(--sans);color:var(--mute)}
.channels a:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:#555}
@media(min-width:820px){.contact{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px}}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 0 40px;font:400 11px var(--mono);color:var(--mute);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

<nav aria-label="Main">
  <a class="logo" href="#top">praneeth</a>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#about">About</a></li>
    <li><a href="#journey">Journey</a></li>
    <li><a href="#focus">Focus</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contact">Contact</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<header class="hero" id="top">
  <div>
    <h1>ECE Diploma <span>Student</span></h1>
    <p class="lead">My goal is to <em>start a VLSI RTL design company</em>. I learn something new every day and use <em>AI</em> to get more done.</p>
    <div class="btn">
      <a class="pill" href="#focus">Focus areas</a>
      <a class="circle solid" href="#focus" aria-label="Go to focus areas">→</a>
    </div>
    <div class="btn" style="margin-top:12px">
      <a class="pill ghost" href="mailto:prnxth@gmail.com">Contact me</a>
      <a class="circle" href="#contact" aria-label="Go to contact">✉</a>
    </div>
    <div class="social">
      <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/kalukuri-praneeth-3b67b1384">Linkedin</a>
      <a href="https://www.instagram.com/tbd.prnxth/">Instagram</a>
      <a href="mailto:prnxth@gmail.com">E-mail</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<section id="about">
  <div class="label">.../About me ...</div>
  <div class="about">
    <div>
      <p class="hello">Hello! I’m <em>Kalukuri Praneeth</em>, a <em>second-year Diploma student</em> in Electronics &amp; Communication Engineering at the Central Institute of Tool Design, Hyderabad. I graduate in 2028.</p>
      <p class="mute" style="margin:16px 0 22px;max-width:52ch">I’m an AI orchestrator and a video editor. My long-term goal is to set up a startup in VLSI RTL design. Outside class I watch anime, read books and pick up something new every day.</p>
      <div class="cards" style="grid-template-columns:1fr">
        <div class="box light"><h3>Currently studying</h3><p>Network Analysis / Electronic Measuring Instruments / Digital Electronics</p></div>
        <div class="box"><h3>Hobbies</h3><p>Anime / Reading books / Learning new things daily</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="art">
  <div class="label">.../Beyond the screen ...</div>
  <div class="gal">
    <figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Anime-style illustration of a figure with a flame for hair, hands together" loading="lazy"><figcaption>Anime art I like</figcaption></figure>
    <figure><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Black and white photo with a spider-mask drawn over the face" loading="lazy"><figcaption>Me, masked</figcaption></figure>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="skills">
  <div class="label">.../Skills ...</div>
  <div class="cards">
    <div class="box light"><h3>AI orchestration</h3><p>Prompting / AI workflows / Automation / Choosing the right AI tool</p></div>
    <div class="box"><h3>Video editing</h3><p>Cutting / Storytelling / Short-form video</p></div>
    <div class="box"><h3>Electronics</h3><p>Network analysis / Measurements / Circuit basics</p></div>
    <div class="box"><h3>Soft skills</h3><p>Self-learning / Curiosity / Reading / Consistency</p></div>
  </div>
  <p class="mute" style="margin-top:18px;font-size:12px">Some of my favorite topics and tools that I work with.</p>
</section>

<section id="education">
  <div class="label">.../Education ...</div>
  <div class="edu">
    <div class="box light"><h3>Central Institute of Tool Design</h3><p>Diploma in Electronics &amp; Communication Engineering / Hyderabad / 2025 – 2028 / Now in 2nd year</p></div>
    <div class="box"><h3>Sri Venkateswara Bala Kuteer</h3><p>School education / Guntur, Andhra Pradesh</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="journey">
  <div class="big mono">Journey</div>
  <div class="rows">
    <div class="row on"><div>2025 – now<small>2nd year</small></div><div><b>CITD, Hyderabad</b><br>Diploma in Electronics &amp; Communication Engineering</div></div>
    <div class="row"><div>Before 2025<small>School</small></div><div><b>Sri Venkateswara Bala Kuteer</b><br>Guntur, Andhra Pradesh</div></div>
    <div class="row"><div>Goal<small>2028 and beyond</small></div><div><b>VLSI RTL design startup</b><br>Learning the digital design skills to get there</div></div>
  </div>
  <p class="total">Still studying, <em>building my foundation</em></p>
</section>

<section id="focus">
  <div class="label">.../Focus areas ...</div>
  <div class="cards" style="grid-template-columns:1fr">
    <div class="box light"><h3>Projects</h3><p>I’m still studying, so my project list is empty for now. Mini projects and circuit builds will be added here as I finish them.</p></div>
    <div class="box"><h3>Path to VLSI</h3><p>Digital electronics / Verilog and RTL design / FPGA basics / Chip design flow</p></div>
    <div class="box"><h3>Using AI</h3><p>Orchestrating AI tools to learn faster, write and edit video</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="contact">
  <div class="label">.../Contacts ...</div>
  <div class="contact">
    <form id="f" novalidate>
      <div><label for="n">Name</label><input id="n" name="name" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Your name" required></div>
      <div><label for="e">Email</label><input id="e" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required></div>
      <div><label for="m">Message</label><textarea id="m" name="message" placeholder="How can I help?" required></textarea></div>
      <div class="btn"><button class="pill" type="submit">Send message</button><span class="circle solid" aria-hidden="true">→</span></div>
      <div class="status" id="s" role="status"></div>
    </form>
    <div>
      <div class="bigname">Kalukuri<span>Praneeth</span><small>ECE diploma student</small></div>
      <div class="channels">
        <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/kalukuri-praneeth-3b67b1384">Linkedin</a>
        <a href="https://www.instagram.com/tbd.prnxth/">Instagram</a>
        <a href="mailto:prnxth@gmail.com">E-mail</a>
        <a href="#top">Back to top</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer><span>Handcrafted by me</span><span>© 2026 Kalukuri Praneeth</span></footer>
</div>

<script>
document.getElementById('f').addEventListener('submit',function(ev){
  ev.preventDefault();
  var s=document.getElementById('s'),n=this.name.value.trim(),e=this.email.value.trim(),m=this.message.value.trim();
  if(!n||!e||!m){s.textContent='Fill in your name, email and message.';return;}
  var body=encodeURIComponent(m+'\n\n– '+n+' ('+e+')');
  window.location.href='mailto:prnxth@gmail.com?subject='+encodeURIComponent('Message from '+n)+'&body='+body;
  s.textContent='Opening your email app to send the message.';
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
